description: Figure 2 presents a comparative analysis of model performance across two experiments, illustrated through four scatter plots arranged in a 2x2 grid. The top two plots, labeled "Before Introspection Training" and "After Introspection Training," compare the relationship between "Learned Attribute Weights" (x-axis) and "Reported Attribute Weights" (y-axis) for the GPT-4o model. The bottom two plots show the same comparison for the GPT-4o-mini model. In each of the four plots, data points are colored blue for the pre-training state and purple for the post-training state, with a gray area representing the baseline. The plots demonstrate a significant improvement in correlation after training, with the Pearson correlation coefficient (r) increasing from .54 to .74 for GPT-4o and from .51 to .75 for GPT-4o-mini, indicating that fine-tuning enhances the models' ability to accurately report their internal decision-making processes.
